title: Witch House by Cosmic Vortex
description: A small red wooden house with a witch standing on its roof sits on a sandy shore beside turbulent ocean waves. A massive skeletal dragon spine curves from the beach into a swirling cosmic vortex filled with stars, glowing orbs, meteors and colorful nebulae in the dramatic night sky.
